description: Texture of USER-SPECIFIED ORNAMENTS hung on a composed line: where texture decorated throws random-shaped bursts at its line, ORNATE plays exact little melodies you write. The notedata file carries line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of the input sound, then TWO OR MORE '#N' note blocks (rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur'): block 1 = the line to ornament (restated every skiptime), blocks 2+ = the ornament shape(s) - with several ornament blocks the engine picks among them. Source-pinned placement (texture4.c:1032-37): PREORNATE forces every ornament BEFORE its line note (plain ornate randomly permutes placement per note; all three siblings verified DISTINCT at the same seed - byte-proof in the tranche-18 findings). Fewer than two blocks refuses 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' (verbatim; extra blocks legal - a 3-block file rendered). Pinned to submode 5 (NONE - no harmonic field; modes 1-4 lock pitches to hfield/hset blocks and add a block to the expected count). multlo/multhi (CDP-enforced 0.01-100, verbatim) scale each ornament statement's total duration relative to the ornamented note. Genuinely stochastic with a WORKING -r seed (-r5 twice 1.2 s apart byte-identical; -r9 differs; unseeded runs differ). Duration honesty: outdur 5 -> 6.24 (+4.7%) , outdur 8 -> 8.61 (+7.6%) - overshoot is roughly the line span plus the last ornament's tail. Breakpoints: every numeric positional accepted a brk file EXCEPT outdur, gpspace and contour (refusals verbatim 'Cannot read parameter 1/14/17'); flags -a/-p/-s brk-capable, seed refused (parameter 30); skiptime brk accepted (exit 0; per-parameter sweep re-run in this mode). Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO. Flags are ORDER-ENFORCED ('option flag -a out of order on cmdline.').
musical_use: As texture ornate, but with DETERMINISTIC placement: every ornament statement lands BEFORE its line note, so the gesture grammar stays consistent across restatements - anacrusis-like upbeat figures, grace-note pickups, written-out appoggiaturas resolving INTO each line note. Use plain ornate when you want the placement itself varied. All other controls behave identically (multlo/multhi pacing, contour/amprise dynamics, -w whole-source halos); the notedata grammar is the same line-block-plus-ornament-blocks file. Always seed to pin a take.

notedata.description: REQUIRED text file (write_data_file()): line 1 = assumed MIDI pitch of each input sound (single value here); then '#N' + N rows 'time infile_no pitch amp dur' for the LINE to ornament; then one or more further '#N' blocks = ornament shapes (times within a block ascending from 0; amp MIDI-style 1-127; dur seconds). Under two blocks: 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

outdur.description: Requested (minimum) duration. Actual overshoots by about the line span plus the final ornament tail: +23% at outdur 5, +9.9% at outdur 8 on the 0.5 s-ping probe - keep line+ornament small relative to outdur when length matters. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

skiptime.description: Time between restatements of the ornamented line (family range 0.000002-100). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0, re-verified in this mode; differ-from-endpoints proof recorded on the ornate sibling).

sndfirst.description: First sound to use from the input list (single-input entry: must be 1). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

sndlast.description: Last sound to use from the input list (must be 1 here). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

mingain.description: Minimum event level 1-127 (family standard). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

mindur.description: Minimum event duration (family floor 0.016). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

maxdur.description: Maximum event duration (>= mindur; values far beyond the input duration fail obscurely - family finding). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

phgrid.description: Timegrid in ms applying WITHIN ornaments (0 = none). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

gpspace.description: Spatialisation of ornament-groups, CDP-enforced 0-5 ('Parameter[11] Value (6.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 5.000000)'): 0 still, 1 scattered (default), 2 towards centre, 3 away, 4/5 follow/counter motion. Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 14') - family manual divergence.

gpsprange.description: Spatial range of ornament-groups 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

amprise.description: Amplitude change within each ornament, 0-127 (default 0 = flat). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

contour.description: Amplitude contour of ornaments, CDP-enforced 0-8 ('Parameter[14] Value (9.000000) out of range (0.000000 to 8.000000)'): 0 mixed, 1 cresc, 2 flat, 3 decresc, 4-6 combinations, 7/8 directed-to-event extras (ornate/decorated family). Breakpoint REFUSED ('Cannot read parameter 17').

multlo.description: Minimum multiplier of each ornament statement's total duration (CDP-enforced 0.01-100: 'Parameter[15] Value (0.000000) out of range (0.010000 to 100.000000)'). Below 1 compresses the written shape in time. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0, rendered).

multhi.description: Maximum ornament-duration multiplier (>= multlo; same enforced range, 200 refused verbatim). The multlo-multhi spread randomises ornament pacing per statement. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

atten.description: Overall attenuation multiplier, CDP-enforced 0.000002-1 ('Parameter[17] Value (1.500000) out of range (0.000002 to 1.000000)'; -a0.5 verified halving RMS). Breakpoint accepted. Flag order enforced: -a before -p -s -r.

position.description: Centre of the stereo image 0-1 (family-enforced; banner default 0.5). Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

spread.description: Spatial spread of texture events 0-1. Breakpoint accepted (exit 0).

seed.description: Random seed - WORKING (-r5 pair 1.2 s apart byte-identical - sha 02bb199488711342 both runs; -r9 differs; unseeded differs). 0/omission = clock. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 30').

whole.description: Play the whole input per event, ignoring mindur/maxdur (verified: changes render in this mode).

samedur.description: Ornament notes all take the duration of the ornamented line note (verified: changes render in this mode).

instrvary.description: Ornaments not confined to the ornamented note's instrument - multi-input only (family no-op on single input; verified on the ornate sibling).

orntop.description: Ornament the HIGHEST note of line chords (family behavior; no-op without chords, verified on the ornate sibling).

ornall.description: Ornament ALL notes of line chords (family behavior; no-op without chords, verified on the ornate sibling).

examples.description: A rising three-note ornament grafted onto a two-note line, restated every 1.5 s.
examples.expected_use:
First write_data_file('nd_orn.txt', '60
#2
0 1 60 64 0.5
1 1 62 64 0.5
#3
0 1 60 64 0.1
0.08 1 62 64 0.1
0.16 1 64 64 0.1'). Every ornament falls BEFORE its line note; rerun with seed 5 for the identical take.

examples.description: Slow arabesques: ornaments stretched 2-4x, crescendo contour, phrase period accelerating via breakpoint skiptime.

known_issues: Duration honesty (set_by outdur): outdur 5 -> 6.24 (+4.7%), outdur 8 -> 8.61 (+7.6%) on the 0.5 s-ping probe (1.5 s line, small ornaments); duration row pinned at outdur 8, tol 0.2, seed 5.

Notedata needs at least TWO '#N' blocks after the pitch line (line, then ornament(s)); one or zero blocks refuse 'Insufficient motifs in notedata file.' verbatim. Extra ornament blocks are legal (3-block file verified).

Placement is FORCED BEFORE each line note (source texture4.c: ISPRE/ISPOST_DECORORN -> vflag[IS_PRE]); plain ornate permutes it randomly. All three siblings differ at the same seed (byte-proof recorded) - pick this mode for consistent gesture direction.
Breakpoint surface re-swept per-parameter in this mode: outdur/gpspace/contour/seed refuse (parameters 1/14/17/30 verbatim); all other numeric positionals plus -a/-p/-s accept (exit 0).
Flags ORDER-ENFORCED: -a -p -s -r then switches ('option flag -a out of order on cmdline.' verbatim).
Mono input only ('Application doesn't work with this type of infile.'); output always STEREO. Working -r seed; -r0/omission = clock.
-i/-h/-e content-dependent no-ops (family finding, verified on the ornate sibling). Modes 1-4 (harmonic fields) remain execute()-only.
skiptime 0 not probed in this mode; the decorated-family hang is content-dependent - never map 0 through.
